summary.text: Sam Low is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 39-Position 1 since January 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Kathryn Lewandowsky.

paragraphs.text: Sam Low was born in Snohomish County, Washington, and lives in Everett, Washington.
He graduated from Everett High School and earned a B.A. in theology and a master's degree in organizational leadership from Maranatha Baptist University.
His career experience includes working as a small business owner.
Low was elected to the Lake Stevens City Council in 2013 and selected as its president in 2016, and he also served as mayor pro-tem.
In 2016, he was elected to the Snohomish County Council, and he served on the Snohomish County Board of Health, including as chair of the Health District.
He assumed office in the Washington House on January 9, 2023.
